name: cypherpoet-apple-human-interface-guidelines
description: Thorough distillation of Apple's complete Human Interface Guidelines across all six platforms (iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, watchOS) — component-by-component best practices, hard specs (tap targets, type sizes, color tokens), per-platform deltas, and choose-the-right-component decision tables, with a synced reference corpus that tracks Apple's updates.
